conclusion: The three independent samplers, genuine trial dispatch, exact finite objective selection, separate search/replication opening, disjoint C/E/A accounting and rejection of old time PASS are connected. The current implementation is not completely closed: campaign resource checks do not cover the terminal shared evaluation/analysis; failure cleanup does not establish disappearance of all owned workers before ending the run interval. New 9000-second/114-hour feasibility remains independently unestablished. A further native disk-reservation omission should be judged against the retained old resource gate, without expanding the task into a general safety framework.

findings.title: E/A and final control can bypass the campaign resource limits after the last training run
findings.trigger: During the actual shared evaluation or independent analysis, campaign evidence/output or the phase process RSS exceeds its retained limit while elapsed time remains below E2400/A600. The parent launch loop checks time and process-group exit only; the last trial's Budget no longer runs.
findings.mechanism: The sole Budget constructor in optuna_run is execute_trial line249. Budget.check implements the campaign 64GiB output and 2GiB evidence checks, and inherited RSS/GPU checks. joint_evaluate never creates or invokes it. --analyze returns directly through independent_analysis before verify's qualification watchdog is initialized. The parent subsequently writes COMPLETE after checking only the access tally.
findings.impact: All 45 runs and the final two children may return success even though the overall campaign resource contract was exceeded after the last run. This concerns ordinary execution coverage; no forged gate, extra candidate or direct helper invocation is required.
findings.minimum_change: Reuse the existing resource checks/watchdog for the actual shared evaluation and analysis and check campaign output in final control. Retain phase-specific E/A time limits without double charging. Monitor the real executing process (or owned group) and preserve observed peak/stop evidence. No new service or broad safety framework is needed.
findings.gate: Fix before approving the formal campaign path as implementation-complete. This missing formal E/A check does not by itself invalidate the already performed CPU tests or prove that native BGE qualification will fail.
findings.evidence_limit: No resources were consumed experimentally by this review; the possible overrun is derived from the real call path and the absent checks. Current fixed outputs might stay below the caps, but the code does not enforce them in these phases.

findings.title: Failure/timeout stops the accounting interval before all owned workers are confirmed released
findings.trigger: A real launched child has a same-process-group worker when an error or timeout occurs. The success loop observes process-group membership, but the exception handler sends SIGKILL to the group and waits only for the group leader.
findings.mechanism: Lines125-130 do not repeat the all-member disappearance check used by lines113-121. child.wait proves only the main child is reaped. The Ledger interval ends as soon as launch raises, so a worker still tearing down or blocked in kernel work is outside that recorded interval.
findings.impact: The campaign correctly stops and does not schedule a replacement, but the stated failure endpoint (all owned workers exited/resources released) and full cleanup cost are not proved. This should not be described as successful worker-release coverage based on the current simple-child test.
findings.minimum_change: Use the same owned-group release observation in the failure cleanup path, preserve the stopped status and actual cleanup duration/any unresolved resources, and never convert cleanup or a time overrun into a fresh training allowance. This is a small completion-path correction, not automatic recovery.
findings.gate: Close before formal execution's failure/resource accounting is accepted. It is not a reason to discard the valid CPU control/sampler evidence or rerun unmodified scientific code.
findings.evidence_limit: Existing CPU launcher tests run a normal child, an exit3 child, and a sleeping child. They create no descendant worker and therefore do not cover this branch. No worker experiment was run externally.

findings.title: The new native six-call path drops the old available-disk reservation check
findings.trigger: The native work directory has less available disk than the required checkpoint reserve, though its current recorded output size plus reserve is within the 10GiB work cap.
findings.mechanism: The old native path explicitly rejects free disk below10GiB. native_save passes checkpoint_reserve to the supplied check, but the new check looks only at elapsed/RSS and current files plus reserve. It does not query actual filesystem free bytes. The new native_arm also lacks the old startup disk check.
findings.impact: BGE loading and real optimizer calls can begin before a checkpoint write hits ENOSPC. The new check enforces an allowed output size, not availability of the physical storage needed to execute the saved-state qualification.
findings.minimum_change: Retain the old startup available-disk check and/or use the already supplied disk_reserve helper from the new check(reserve), without adding a new resource architecture.
findings.gate: If the old physical-space gate is retained by the current native specification, close before native execution. It does not establish that present storage is insufficient; no project filesystem was inspected by this review.

The new timing gate uses the same conservative full-run seconds for both P_search and P_rep. That is conservative for a replication excluding final label evaluation if the same workload assumptions hold; it is not a bug requiring artificially lower replication projections.

The old projection computes projected_peak_output_bytes/within_budget as well. New validate_gate uses only projected_total_seconds. Because the current scope explicitly freezes the time projection conditions, and the source-bound BGE shape/native temporary cap constrain actual file sizes, merely fabricating giant W_F/W_I is not a sound independent ordinary-input defect. The full campaign's18 retained inference weights still require capacity accounting before formal qualification.

The new native L measurement excludes pretrained_archive hashing at optuna_verify99-100. The old timed checked_fresh at positive_verify71 includes archive verification through g_half_verify107-110.
